1879048834.Skill_Desc: You auto-attack when wielding a two-handed weapon.

1879064066.Skill_Desc: You reflect damage to your attacker when hit.

1879064194.Skill_Desc: Calling upon the Valar can send certain evil foes fleeing in terror for a short time.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Fear replaced with attack speed debuff.</rgb>

1879096322.Skill_Desc: You perform a melody so irresistible that all Free Peoples who hear it cannot help but dance.

1879109122.Skill_Desc: Written words can have a chilling effect on their victim. Slows your foe, but damaging them will return their speed.

1879110402.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#00FFDD>Affinity - Fire
Affinity skills will change their effects when you use an elemental skill (frost, fire, lightning).</rgb>

A Rune-sign will not only inspire, but infuses an ally with minor elemental powers.

1879145602.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Sûri-kylä in Forochel.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879157634.Skill_Desc: A single target forcet attack that also generates threat.  This skill is used often.

1879198338.Skill_Desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879207042.Skill_Desc: This mount is draped in the colours of the noble and valiant Soldiers of Minas Ithil, a personal escort and unit that took orders directly from Isildur.

1879214594.Skill_Desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879214978.Skill_Desc: When dazed, stunned, knocked down, or knocked out you may turn the tables on your enemy, recovering from the effects and instilling them in your enemy. This attack can not be Blocked, Parried, Evaded or Miss an on level opponent.

1879248386.Skill_Desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Light-based damage projectiles toward your target.

1879284098.Skill_Desc: Place a banner that improves Engineers.

1879301250.Skill_Desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Helmingas, you're able to quickly return to Helm's Deep in western Rohan. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879316482.Skill_Desc: Summons a grim to your side. A jacket is recommended.
1879316482.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter in the Yule Festival.

1879324034.Skill_Desc: Summons a sheep to keep you company.
1879324034.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from participating in the story of Bingo Boffin. May be bartered for in Bree-land.

1879329154.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Minas Tirith.

1879329794.Skill_Desc: Summons a beetle to keep you company.
1879329794.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter with the Burgsmen's Fellowship in Minas Tirith.

1879369986.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.
1879369986.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879394562.Skill_Desc: A noble fallow deer dressed for the season.

1879440130.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from completing Gundabad: Reclaiming The Mountain.

1879449986.Skill_Desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

1879466242.Skill_Desc: With a quick flick of your blade, interrupt your target's focus.

1879467266.Skill_Desc: Sing to West Wind, on which flows the call To Arms, strengthening your allies.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's To Arms Damage buff.</rgb>

1879475970.Skill_Desc: You're able to quickly return to Halrax in the Shield Isles. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879489154.Skill_Desc: Your companion lends you a piece of their nobility, granting you a small measure of hope and comfort even in dark times.

1879491074.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.
1879491074.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from Hobbit Presents as a special Gold Winter Gift.

1879508098.Skill_Desc: Nock and loose an imprecise dart, which has a chance to greatly increase your Focus if it lands.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879508738.Skill_Desc: You're able to quickly return to Zajâna in Kighân in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879518722.Skill_Desc: Use to rally the allied soldiers in Emax Dûl.

1879525122.Skill_Desc: The traditional critic's commentary on a poor performance. Also works great on friends.
1879525122.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: The traditional critic's commentary on a poor performance. Also works great on friends.\n\nAvailable from completing 'Frostbluff Rotten Fruit -- Tier 3'.

1879525378.Skill_Desc: Set off some festive tree-shaped fireworks!
1879525378.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Set off some festive tree-shaped fireworks!\n\nAvailable from the 9-year Giftbox.
